description: This Java class defines the OrderProductPrice entity for managing product pricing information within an order in an e-commerce system. It includes fields for base and special prices, price codes, date ranges for special prices, and relationships to other entities such as OrderProduct.

classes.name: OrderProductPrice
classes.description: Entity class representing pricing details of an order product, including price codes, normal and special prices, date ranges for special prices, and a link to the OrderProduct.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of this OrderProductPrice.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this OrderProductPrice.

methods.name: getDefaultPrice
methods.description: Returns whether this is the default price.

methods.name: setDefaultPrice
methods.description: Sets whether this is the default price.

methods.name: getProductPriceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the product price.

methods.name: setProductPriceName
methods.description: Sets the name of the product price.

methods.name: setOrderProduct
methods.description: Associates this price with an OrderProduct.

methods.name: getProductPriceSpecialStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date for special pricing.

methods.name: setProductPriceSpecialStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date for special pricing.

methods.name: getProductPriceSpecialEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date for special pricing.

methods.name: setProductPriceSpecialEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date for special pricing.
